newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $431 bln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $431 bln for Tuesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesdayare expected to total $431 million in 30 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $273 billion in six sales, with a $150 million Sacramento Municipal Utility District, Calif., deal through Goldman, Sachs & Co., topping the list.
On the competitive side, 24 sales totaling $158 million are scheduled. A $27 million Freehold Township Board of Education, N.J., deal at 1100 EDT is the largest.
An additional 15 sales totaling $536 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Tuesday depending on market conditions.
